VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria satisfaction. While the agent claims all 31 tests pass and describes the fix in detail, there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, diffs, or artifacts) to corroborate these claims. The acceptance criteria explicitly requires that "all 31 tests pass," which demands verifiable proof, not assertion. Self-reports are the weakest admissibility class and cannot establish objective test results without supporting documentation.
